text:
Keyloop DMS – Dealer Management System
Keyloop DMS

Your DMS forms the foundation of your business. The best dealer management systems allow you to run your dealership's sales, service, parts and accounting in one place. It connects your team, your manufacturers and your partner ecosystem.

Get started
Join the companies transforming their operations with Keyloop’s Dealer Management Systems.

With Keyloop, the great thing is we have a 360 degree view. What we’re able to do is pull every single part of the customer journey together in one place, which is critical for us. We can look at car sales, finance, service functions and then start to build the whole picture for the customer. It gives us great visibility.

Stephen Lay

Director, MHD

Read their success story
Connected retail through dealer management excellence.

Automotive retail margins are under serious pressure, and customer expectations keep rising. We’ve built our dealer management systems to address the core challenges of every modern retailer.  

Data sharing and insights

Your dealer management software shares data across systems in real time, cutting the manual reporting that eats into your day. 

Digital transformation

Move from paper processes to a connected dealer management system without disrupting how your teams already work.

Choice and flexibility

Keep the car dealer software tools and integrations that work for your business. The right DMS connects them rather than replacing them.

A future-proof platform

Built to extend as automotive retail software requirements change, not to be rebuilt every few years. 

Refining operations for your automotive retail group

Keyloop’s DMS serves as the foundation for retailers, efficiently managing retail group operations. Our open API operational layer connects the DMS data to approved applications from manufacturers and partners. To enhance performance in sales or service teams, retailers can choose additional Keyloop solutions, tailoring the technology to meet specific business goals. We back this up with expert professional services, that deliver dedicated support and training for speedy and successful implementation.

 

A connected foundation for dealership operations

Bring together core operational systems to increase accuracy, reduce manual effort and support financial and operational transparency across every part of the dealership.

OPERATE
Keyloop DMS

Keyloop DMS is part of Fusion Automotive Retail Platform's Operate domain, which underpins your business with peak operational efficiency. It helps you connect, enable and account for your financial transparency by unifying systems, enabling real-time data flow and simplifying financial control. This reduces rekeying, improves accuracy and gives you the agility to adapt quickly to change.
